top_signals.title: Hafnia Wins Danish Shipping’s Diversity Award Again
top_signals.summary: The theme of Danish Shipping’s 2026 Diversity Award is “Small Changes, Big Impact,” and with the jury naming Hafnia this year’s winner, the company has now received Danish Shipping’s Diversity Award three times since it was first presented in 2022.In reaching its decision…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
